Name: Pink Sweety Amusement Park
Author: YellowSlime233
Description:
粉白色系，由爱心，蝴蝶结还有粉色玫瑰装点的游乐园，超出片的❛˓◞˂̵✧

使用的最新版的ff制作，绝大部分家具都添加了发光还有旋转功能。

小径是由AT添加，三种铁轨由木头小径替换，粉白地砖由红砖地板替换。

两种摩天轮，其中一个拥有动画可以旋转。

小火车，旋转木马还有马车均添加了坐位。

最重要的一点，城堡是可以进去的！只是需要你安装PIF，如果不安装那么这个城堡只是一个单纯的摆件。(在此感谢[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url]﻿为我提供的代码帮助！)
[s]不过目前城堡内部我只加了一个简单的原版农舍试验了一下功能为之后制作城堡的内部房间做准备。[/s]
[s]现在没有限制这个城堡可以链接的内部地图，可以先自行更换进去后的PIF地图(如果你有其他PIF地图的话)。

[/s]25.08.15 将pif地图置换成一个完整的室内空间（非常巨大！），依然没有限制城堡可以链接的pif地图，也没有限制这个pif地图可以使用的pif门.
关于这个pif地图的介绍可以查阅我的另一个模组:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36694]Luxurious Large Villa[/url].

25.08.15 为pif地图添加昼夜差分，注意，[color=#ff7700]MMAP是可选择性下载的，不安装地图依然会有昼夜差分，只是背景不会随着视角移动也不会随着时间渐变交替[/color]

欢迎关注我的xhs榴莲牛奶流心牛角包，如果你喜欢我做的美化，可以向我投喂ฅ ˃ ᵕ ˂ ฅ~
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Pink and white themed amusement park decorated with hearts, bows, and pink roses, looking better than the film ❛˓◞˂̵

The latest version of ff was used to create it, and most of the furniture has been added with glowing and rotating functions.

The paths were added by AT, the three types of train tracks were replaced with wooden paths, and the pink and white tiles were replaced with red brick floors.

There are two Ferris wheels, one of has an animation that can rotate.

The little train, carousel, and carriage have all been added with seats.

The most important thing is that the castle isable! You just need to install PIF, if you don't install it, then this castle is just a simple ornament.(Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url]﻿ for the code help!)
[s]However, at present, I only added simple original farmhouse inside the castle to test the function for later production of the castle's interior rooms.[/s]
[s]There is no limit to which interior map this castle can link to you can change the PIF map that enters (if you have other PIF maps).[/s]
25.08.15
Replace the pif map with a complete indoor space (very huge!), still without limiting the pif maps that the castle can link to, nor limiting the pif doors that this pif map can use
You can refer to my other mod for an introduction to this pif map:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36694]Luxurious Large Villa[/url]

25.08.15
Add a day night difference to the pif map. [color=#ff7700]Note that MMAP can be selectively downloaded, and there will still be a day night difference without installing. However, the background will not move with the perspective or gradually alternate over time[/color]
